# Issue #013: Enhanced Action Chaining with Conditional Logic

## Description
Improve the action chaining functionality to support more complex workflows with conditional execution paths, error recovery, and result capture.

## Requirements
- Implement conditional action execution based on page state
- Support branching logic in action chains
- Allow for data extraction during chain execution to influence later steps
- Implement robust error handling and recovery options
- Support for loops and repetitive actions until a condition is met
- Add ability to retry failed actions with configurable attempts
- Create comprehensive logging of action chain execution

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Conditional action execution works based on page state
- [ ] Branching logic correctly follows different execution paths
- [ ] Data extraction during execution properly influences subsequent steps
- [ ] Error handling and recovery mechanisms work as expected
- [ ] Looping actions continue until specified conditions are met
- [ ] Failed actions can be retried with configurable attempt limits
- [ ] Action chain execution is properly logged with detailed status information

## Technical Implementation
Enhance the existing action chaining functionality in the puppeteer.ts file and create a comprehensive test script (`test-advanced-chaining.js`) to validate all conditional and advanced chaining features.

## Related Components
- src/puppeteer.ts (chain function)
- tests/test-action-chaining.js (extend this approach)
